hints.title: Fractional Knapsack Formulation
hints.text: Items can be partitioned fractionally to fill the exact capacity.

hints.title: Capacity Feasibility Check
hints.text: If total sum of item weights is strictly less than capacity, it is impossible to fill the bag completely.

hints.title: Price Density Ordering
hints.text: Sort items descending by price-to-weight ratio price / weight and take as much weight as possible from the highest density items first.

hints.title: Fractional Knapsack Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting items by unit value density followed by greedy linear pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining non-greedy item fractions is suboptimal by greedy exchange argument.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond input array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes classic fractional knapsack and uses price-to-weight density sorting.
